title: peucedanum mouterdei
intro: Peucedanum mouterdei, commonly known as Syrian masterwort, is a plant species native to the Mediterranean region, belonging to the carrot family (Apiaceae). The plant is valued for its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, making it useful in treating various health conditions such as fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Peucedanum mouterdei include its expectorant and diuretic properties, which help in relieving respiratory congestion and reducing fluid retention in the body. The bioactive constituents of this plant include volatile oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
